title: A sidebar that follows your finger · 0.4.1
description: Swipe right anywhere and the chat slides aside to reveal the sidebar, following your finger; swipe left to close.
notes: Swipe right anywhere on the chat and it slides aside to reveal your conversations, tracking your finger the whole way; swipe left anywhere to close.
Where you let go, and how fast you flick, decides whether it stays open; a swipe interrupted by scrolling settles cleanly.
Tap the dimmed strip of chat to close the sidebar. The blue edge tab and the drag handle are gone.
A light haptic when the sidebar opens or closes.
